title: Beloved
author: Toni Morrison
summary: In 1870s Ohio, Sethe, a formerly enslaved woman, lives in a house haunted by the spirit of her baby daughter. When a mysterious young woman called Beloved arrives, the past she has tried to escape is pulled closer.
readIf: you want a demanding, beautiful novel that treats the legacy of slavery as living memory.
skipIf: you want an easy read; it is emotionally heavy and structurally complex.

pairings.reason: Another novel that makes slavery immediate, through a modern woman pulled back into the past.
Another Black American classic about women surviving cruelty, with more hope.
A horror novel in which a past wrong comes back in a very physical form.
